title: A hung main base stops its heartbeat too
goal: A main base whose process lives but whose event loop or scheduler is stuck stops sending heartbeats, so the watcher sees it
acceptance: A test blocks the main base's scheduler or brain and shows heartbeats stop within the limit (failing first if they keep going)
The heartbeat reports liveness of the part that delivers reminders, not only of the socket
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one liveness source and one blocked-loop test. Not a measurement.
